exact_excerpts.interpretation: Capability intent and implementation health are separate. A broken or incomplete Mnemos realization may still represent a required capability; first reconstruct the complete capability model and intended behavior, then use the existing system as a realization reference while comparing simpler and more elegant complete implementations.

claims: The existing Mnemos system is a required capability-discovery and implementation reference, but current habit, implementation health or a single designer's authority is not automatically correct.
Earlier constitutions, contracts, reviewers and agents have no automatic successor-design truth precedence.
Reviewer agreement can inform but cannot replace claim-specific correctness.

A method should compare competing claims without fixed precedence, separate capability intent from realization health, and preserve the user's legitimate product-value role without treating that role as empirical proof.

limitations: These bytes establish user product values and design authorization scope. They do not prove empirical, safety, architecture, performance or migration claims.
